question_text: A government employee has the following leave credits at the start of the year: Vacation Leave (VL) = 15 days, Sick Leave (SL) = 15 days. During the year, she filed for 3 days of VL and 2 days of SL. She also earned 2.5 days of VL and 2.5 days of SL for the year. What is her total remaining leave credits at the end of the year?
